Privacy policy

Secret Expedition: Jungle and Secret Expedition: Jungle Lite

Effective date: 23 October 2026

The short version

This policy covers both apps, Secret Expedition: Jungle and Secret Expedition: Jungle Lite ("the app"), made by Marek Kožuch.

The app does not collect, send or share any information about you. It has no internet access, no accounts, no ads and no analytics. Everything you create in the game stays on your phone.

What the app keeps on your phone

To run the game, the app saves a few things in its own private storage on the phone. Other apps cannot read them, and they are never sent anywhere.

Treasure spots and photos: the GPS position of each hidden treasure and two photos per treasure (the treasure and its hiding spot). They are deleted when the game ends, when it is abandoned, or when the Keeper starts over. Photos never go to your gallery. Photos are saved without location or other hidden information (EXIF).

The game's PIN: only a scrambled form (a salted hash), never the PIN itself. It is deleted with the game.

The history: nicknames, date and time, results and stars of the last 100 games. It never contains photos or places.

Also: the last 10 nicknames, your settings, and two small notes (whether the app has asked for the notification permission, and whether you have seen the introduction).

Please use nicknames, not real names.

What the app does not do

The app has no internet permission, so Android does not let it go online. It has no accounts or sign-up, no ads, no analytics or tracking, no crash-reporting tools and no advertising ID.

Its data is left out of cloud backups and out of transfers to a new phone. We, the makers, never see any of it. The two apps do not share any data with each other.

Permissions and why

Location (precise): only while you mark a treasure spot or while a hunt is running. The app never asks for location in the background. It is used only on the phone.

Camera: to take the treasure photos.

Notifications and a foreground service: a notification shows that the game is running, so the hunt keeps going with the screen off. You can say no; the game still works.

Vibration and keeping the phone awake: for the detector and to keep the game clock right while the screen is off.

Children

The app is for all ages. Children should play outdoors, in safe places, with a grown-up nearby. The app does not collect personal information from anyone, including children. In the Lite app, the "Get the full version" button is behind a question for grown-ups and only opens Google Play.

How long things are kept and how to delete them

Photos, treasure spots and the PIN: until the game ends. History: up to 100 games; older ones are deleted automatically, and "Clear history" erases it at any time. Everything else stays until you uninstall the app or clear its storage in Android settings, which deletes all of it.

Because we never receive your data, there is nothing to delete on our side.

Google Play

You download the app (and buy the full version) through Google Play, which has its own privacy policy. Google may show us combined statistics, such as the number of installs, or crash reports from phones whose owners agreed to share them with Google. These do not include your photos, nicknames or places from the game. When "Show me on Google Play" in the Lite app opens Google Play, Google's privacy policy applies there.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new text and date will be in the app update and on this page.

Contact

Questions? Write to marek_kozuch@protonmail.com. If you write to us, we use your e-mail only to answer you and don't share it.
